title: Use pgvector when semantic retrieval is explicit

why_now: Embeddings plus semantic retrieval are direct evidence for vector distance search inside PostgreSQL.
why_not_yet: Keep lexical search, metadata filters, tenant permissions, and deletion behavior in the retrieval plan.
triggers_for_next_stage: Choose HNSW or IVFFlat after recall, latency, memory, and refresh tests are measured.

why_now: HNSW is a likely default when recall and latency beat sequential vector scans.
why_not_yet: Do not build ANN indexes before embedding volume and recall targets are known.
triggers_for_next_stage: Adopt when an offline evaluation set proves recall and p95 latency.
